svg.title: Reproduce the supported M3 gates
svg.desc: Linux build prerequisites and authorized SSH access to exact Hive/DeTTa sources are documented in the runbook; public HTTPS retrieves the pinned Reachability/PLN sources. New native objects, Python/Janus venv and DeTTa Cargo target are built in a fresh directory. Download caches may be warm. build_m3.py preserves the M2 build recipe and adds the explicit deduction profile. verify_m3.py runs M2 regression, isolated M3 fixtures, upstream guards, native deduction/admission, actual process kills, real native Hive and controlled substitution. The final record was executed from clean detached /tmp/fusion-m3-verify-1af3979. Do not publish broad local environment files. Deck generation is a separate documentation operation and does not rerun these gates.
svg.text: Use the tested revision or a reviewed descendant, with source access and a fresh destination.
VERIFY M1/M2 + C3/C4 + NATIVE HIVE + CONTROLLED SWAP
Read: manifest.json → final/verification.json → suite logs → final/comparison.json
Source access, fixture tests, native execution and archived evidence are separate reproducibility requirements.
OMEGA × ASI / THROUGH M3 / runbook.md · build_m3.py · verify_m3.py
